latency.limitation: Batched model and CPU routing measurements; not Android camera latency

method.pixel_transform: Bilinear inverse sampling at pixel centers; float64 coordinates and float32 interpolation; outside=source RGBmean
method.matching: Actual NMS proposals only; both zoom proposal and projected original box complete within frozen edgeMargin; one-to-one greedy IoU>=.5
method.dot_combination: Original and matched zoom dots: logit mean then probability mean; unmatched original dots stay unchanged
method.routing: First accepted text in fixed order; original geometry, scores and quality check unchanged; no GT access
method.actual_selected_zoom_execution: Only if the selected policy still rejects after its identity/flip prefix
